output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow, allowing minted tokens to be retrieved arbitrarily by the contract owner.
The transferFrom function allows a user to transfer tokens to arbitrary addresses, allowing a potential attacker to steal all tokens from a user's account.
The buy function has an integer overflow, allowing a potential attacker to set the buyRate to 0 and increase the contract balance arbitrarily.
The withdrawToOwner function allows a potential attacker to withdraw any ERC20 token to any address, aka the 'withdrawal' issue.
The transfer function allows a potential attacker to transfer any tokens to any address, aka the 'transferAll' issue.
